methods.what: Attraction (potential-type) volume integral of the x-component of an inverse-square force
Evaluation of $\int c\,dx/(c^2+x^2)^{3/2}$ by the substitution $x=c\tan\varphi$, giving a difference of sines
Result of the definite integral expressed as a difference of sines or cosines
Closed-form expressions for the attraction of a rectangle (double integral result)
First and second partial derivatives of $1/r$ and $x/r$
Relations between semi-axes of confocal surfaces with a parameter
